claims.statement: Identified as the sitter of the Lady with an Ermine. The identification rests on the ermine emblem and a sonnet by Bellincioni.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Interpretive identification.
